title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
source: Source: 8 Track Master Reel > 1st Gen Reel (7.5ips) > PCM (Sony Beta ESXHiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by Bob Menke; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 1.5 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a funky, psychedelic night at the Shrine with solid performance
ai_review.review: The show is praised as another awesome, funky and psychedelic evening at the Shrine, worthy of attention despite a stronger previous night. Charlie Miller and his team made the most of the material they had, delivering a clear‑enough soundboard recording that lets the music shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Single positive review (4★) highlights an enjoyable performance and a decent soundboard capture, yielding an overall rating around four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Engineers did the best they could with the material; generally clear and listenable though no specific high‑fidelity praise is given.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Funky, psychedelic vibe throughout; reviewers describe it as another awesome night at the Shrine.
